area: Ecology: I4 fauna of Harvest and 13 other arcade cells
summary: At I4 in a one-element arcade game, a cell's authored fauna species are now cloned with their element pinned to the game's element (Harvest's fauna are all Space variants at I4, not spread across elements). Garrett's I4 card: arenas with fauna keep theirs, recoloured to the element. No asset edited; Cell.RebuildFaunaRoster.
